name: inspections
description: Inspections checklist template: sites, inspection templates, checklist items, inspections and findings with their picklists, page layouts, and a validation rule plus a flow that stop an inspection with an open high-severity finding from being marked passed.

data.name: sites
data.description: Places that get inspected: warehouses, stores, offices, plants

data.name: inspection-templates
data.description: Reusable checklists, such as fire safety or food hygiene

data.name: checklist-items
data.description: The questions an inspector answers for a template

data.name: inspections
data.description: One visit to a site against a template

data.name: findings
data.description: Problems an inspector recorded during an inspection

data.name: openHighFindings
data.description: Kept up to date by the flow Count open high-severity findings

data.name: No pass with open high-severity findings
data.error_message: An inspection with an open high-severity finding cannot be marked passed. Resolve the finding or mark the inspection failed.

data.help_text_override: Kept up to date from the findings. While it is above zero the inspection cannot be marked passed.

data.name: Count open high-severity findings
data.description: Keeps inspections.openHighFindings equal to the inspection's open high-severity findings

definition.Comment: Recounts the open high-severity findings of the finding's inspection and stores the count on the inspection, where the validation rule "No pass with open high-severity findings" reads it. A passed inspection that gains an open high-severity finding is moved back to In progress.
